LanguageData.LP_Gene_CelestialLineage.label: celestial duty
LanguageData.LP_Gene_CelestialLineage.description: Celestial blood loathes things that flee death: +25% damage against liches and necromantic constructs; mood -5 when seeing a lich and -4 when seeing a necromantic construct, and liches also get mood -5 when seeing an aasimar. Anyone with this gene counts as an aasimar.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_CelestialLineage.customEffectDes: Counts as an aasimar (race checks, choosing ritual, child of the heavens).
Damage against liches and necromantic constructs: ×125%.
Holy damage stops troll regeneration for 1 hour, like fire.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_CelestialResistance.label: celestial resistance
LanguageData.LP_Gene_CelestialResistance.description: Holy light knows this body, and necrotic power has a hard time corroding it: holy, divine punishment and necrotic damage halved.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_HealingHands.label: healing hands
LanguageData.LP_Gene_HealingHands.description: Laying hands on the wounded closes their wounds: each wound heals (Medicine level/2 + Social level/2). Can't regrow lost limbs. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_RadiantSoul.label: celestial revelation: radiant soul
LanguageData.LP_Gene_RadiantSoul.description: A flash of wings of light: leap far away (vanilla longjump, cooldown 1 day). One of three celestial revelations.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_RadiantConsumption.label: celestial revelation: radiant consumption
LanguageData.LP_Gene_RadiantConsumption.description: A toggleable searing light: while on, enemies within 2 cells take 2 holy damage per second, and you take 1 burn damage every 10 seconds. One of three celestial revelations.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_NecroticShroud.label: celestial revelation: necrotic shroud
LanguageData.LP_Gene_NecroticShroud.description: Cloak yourself in the shadow of death: living enemies within 4 cells flee in terror for 8 seconds. Cooldown 1 day. One of three celestial revelations.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_Halo.label: celestial halo
LanguageData.LP_Gene_Halo.description: A faint halo floats overhead, colored after the hair. Purely cosmetic.
LanguageData.LP_SkinAasimarGold.label: pale gold skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinAasimarGold.description: An aasimar's skin has a faint golden sheen.
LanguageData.LP_SkinAasimarSilver.label: silver-white skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinAasimarSilver.description: An aasimar's skin is white and gleaming, like silver under moonlight.
LanguageData.LP_HairAasimarGold.label: golden hair
LanguageData.LP_HairAasimarSilver.label: silver hair
LanguageData.LP_Gene_FiendishBlood.label: fiendish lineage
LanguageData.LP_Gene_FiendishBlood.description: An ancestor made a pact with a devil, and it shows on the face. Non-tiefling colonists get mood -2 (outsider) when seeing a tiefling who hasn't lived in the colony for a full year; aasimar have -3 opinion of tieflings, turning into +3 (friend of fate) once both have lived there a full year. Anyone with this gene counts as a tiefling.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_FiendishBlood.customEffectDescri: Counts as a tiefling (race checks, choosing ritual, child of the heavens).
LanguageData.LP_Gene_InfernalResistance.label: infernal resistance
LanguageData.LP_Gene_InfernalResistance.description: The fire of the Nine Hells has burned in the blood: fire and burn damage halved.
LanguageData.LP_Gene_HellishRebuke.label: hellish rebuke
LanguageData.LP_Gene_HellishRebuke.description: When hit in melee, a 25% chance to return 10 burn damage of hellfire to the attacker (at most once every 10 seconds).
LanguageData.LP_Gene_InfernalPact.label: devil's bargain
LanguageData.LP_Gene_InfernalPact.description: Can haggle with the devil one more time: mood -10 (3 days) in exchange for +20% shooting and melee damage and +20% psyfocus gain for 24 hours; then 12 hours of "pact overdraft" (consciousness -10%). Cooldown 5 days.
